topic: Audio render callback preparation and bounded handoff
evidence_scope: Official interface documentation and fixed public source reading; original unexecuted engineering example. No audio device access, build, playback, recording or concurrency validation.

sources.title: portaudio.h callback and stream interface
sources.read_scope: Callback time information, flags, return values, complete PaStreamCallback documentation, stream opening and frame count, stopping and CPU load documentation.
sources.supports: Fill the entire output buffer according to the actual frame count; avoid blocking and unpredictable work. Data duration, callback time and first output sample time are different quantities.
sources.does_not_support: A universal exclusive CPU budget, measured end-to-end latency, guaranteed uninterrupted playback, or treatment of every middleware notification as the same callback type.

sources.title: Writing a Callback Function
sources.version_scope: Rolling v19 documentation, not a fixed installed binary identity
sources.read_scope: Complete page and short example; example not executed or copied into the library.
sources.supports: Unpredictable-duration allocation, I/O and synchronization cannot be made safe merely by assuming the ordinary thread will finish soon.

sources.title: Single-reader/single-writer ring buffer interface and implementation
sources.read_scope: Complete header and implementation; not a full review of platform memory-barrier branches.
sources.supports: The described utility has a single producer and consumer, preallocated backing storage, power-of-two capacity, actual read/write counts and a flush precondition excluding concurrent reads or writes.
sources.does_not_support: A general multi-producer container, arbitrary-language memory-model proof, caller object lifetime management or a project-specific overflow policy.

sources.title: Studio API Guide
sources.read_scope: Sections 13.4 and 13.11, command processing and event notification, read by the source author to distinguish callback responsibilities.
sources.supports: Studio event notifications should not be equated with the PortAudio sample-buffer callback solely because both are called callbacks.

original_example_scope: A prepared cutting-tool motor sound, nominal frame duration and a finite control-message handoff. No queue implementation, scheduler bound, actual resource reclamation protocol or audible result has been tested.
deduplication: The existing music-switching reader explains musical intent and notification; the PCM-loop reader explains sample intervals. This topic concerns filling the current output block despite unavailable ordinary-thread work.
